summary: Armada Acquisition Corp. II, a blank-check company, filed an 8-K reporting a routine working capital loan. On July 27, 2026, it entered an unsecured promissory note with its sponsor, Arrington XRP Capital Fund, borrowing $135,000 initially, with possible additional draws at the sponsor's discretion. Interest accrues at the short-term Applicable Federal Rate; the note matures upon termination of the Business Combination Agreement with Evernorth Holdings, Pathfinder Digital Assets, and Ripple Labs or consummation of that deal. This is a standard SPAC working capital facility, not a special-situation event. What to watch: ongoing SPAC de-SPAC transaction progress.
